body: The first ray of morning sun gently spilled into the small courtyard, and ※11⛬ slowly opened his eyes, stretching with a big yawn.
The ※5⛬ beside him was also woken by his movement, sitting up with a 'whoosh', his eyes still a bit blurry.
※11⛬ looked at ※5⛬ and said with a smile, "Little guy, time to get up! It's time for our morning exercise."
※5⛬ shook his body, his spikes making a slight 'rustling' sound with his movements. He lifted his head and looked at ※11⛬ with his dark, round eyes.
"※10⛬, ※10⛬!" He seemed to be responding to his master, with a hint of excitement in his tone.

Arriving on the path outside the courtyard, ※11⛬ began his warm-up exercises. He twisted his waist and rotated his wrists and ankles, moving as he spoke, "※5⛬, you need to train hard today and unleash all your potential."
※5⛬, meanwhile, bounced a few times beside him, his spikes gleaming coldly in the sunlight. He cried out loudly, "※10⛬!" as if cheering himself on.
The morning run began. ※11⛬'s steps were light and his breathing even. His gaze was firm and focused, fixed on the road ahead.
※5⛬, carrying a weight, powerfully trod on the ground with his four feet, raising a small cloud of dust with each step.
He followed closely behind ※11⛬, occasionally letting out 'huffing and puffing' sounds, but his eyes were full of stubbornness, as if competing with ※11⛬, determined to finish the run before him.
After running for a while, ※11⛬ felt a bit strained and his pace gradually slowed down.
Seeing this, ※10⛬ sped up and ran beside ※11⛬, rubbing his head against his leg.
The sound seemed to be encouraging ※11⛬, and also showing off his own stamina.
※11⛬ smiled and reached out to pat ※5⛬'s head, but accidentally pricked himself on a spike.
"Ouch, you little rascal, so spiky and still so mischievous."
※5⛬ seemed to realize his "mistake," lowering his head and making a 'whimpering' sound, as if apologizing.
However, both of them still completed today's morning exercise.
Ever since ※11⛬ arrived in this ※13⛬ world, he had deeply understood the importance of physical training for a ※9⛬.
Venturing into the wild without a strong body would make it impossible to withstand the harsh environment.
Recalling his days in the orphanage, despite having the system's help, the conditions were too poor, lacking even basic supplements.
Even though he had always insisted on exercising, his physical fitness was only slightly better than his peers.
However, ever since undergoing the transformation of ※0⛬, he clearly felt his physical strength instantly double.
Now, as he continuously used ※0⛬, his body continued to strengthen. He eagerly looked forward to the day when he could become a "Super True Human" like those legendary powerhouses.
The reason ※11⛬ was willing to exercise with ※5⛬ was because there were benefits.
This not only stimulated ※5⛬'s enthusiasm for training but also deepened their bond, allowing them to cooperate more tacitly in battle.
Moreover, it could also enhance physical fitness.
Although ※11⛬'s body was good now, compared to a ※13⛬, the gap was huge.
Take ※12⛬, which has average physical strength, it is many times stronger than him.
In the past, ※11⛬'s morning run was five kilometers; now that his body has improved, it has increased to ten kilometers.
As for ※5⛬, he had to run with a weight, previously ten kilometers, now increased to twenty kilometers, and he still had to finish before ※11⛬.
Fortunately, ※5⛬ had evolved; if he were still a ※6⛬ before, it would probably be very difficult to complete such a training task.

After the exercise, they returned home for breakfast. ※11⛬, while eating bread, said to ※5⛬, "I plan to go to the city's breeding house today. The city is safer, so you don't need to come along. You can train well at home."
Upon hearing this, ※10⛬, who was slowly chewing his food, immediately stopped, his eyes wide.
"※10⛬! ※10⛬!" He stood up, his front paws restlessly scratching the ground, showing strong dissatisfaction.
※11⛬ looked at him helplessly,
"What are you doing? I'm doing this for your own good. Training at home is great; it can increase your strength."
※5⛬ didn't listen at all, running directly to ※11⛬, blocking his way with his body, and continuously calling out:
He looked as if he was saying:
"I don't care, I'm going with you."
※11⛬ sighed,
"You insist on coming along? Alright then, but you have to be obedient."
Only then did ※5⛬ quiet down, his eyes sparkling with joy.
He jumped up happily, almost knocking over the table.
As they prepared to depart, ※11⛬ got on his bicycle and looked at ※5⛬, saying, "You've evolved now, so you can't sit in the basket anymore. You either run along, or go into your ※7⛬.
Of course, you can also choose not to go."
※5⛬ tilted his head, thought for a moment, his eyes darting around, and then said:
※11⛬ smiled and said, "I know, you want to run for a bit first, then go into your ※7⛬, and come out when we reach the city, right? You really are a guy who loves to join in the fun."
※10⛬ happily cried out:
His voice was full of cheerfulness.
And so, ※11⛬ slowly cycled forward. After ※5⛬ ran alongside for a while, he voluntarily entered his ※7⛬.
※11⛬ hung the ※7⛬ on his waist and cycled towards the city, his heart full of anticipation for today's itinerary.
And ※5⛬ in the ※7⛬ seemed to be quietly waiting for the excitement to arrive once they reached the city.
※11⛬ stepped into the city, and a bustling scene immediately greeted him. The streets were filled with traffic and pedestrians, and the shops along the roadside were dazzling.
He stood at the street corner, a hint of curiosity and exploration in his eyes, squinting slightly as he surveyed the city's prosperity.
"There are quite a few breeding houses in ※3⛬."
※11⛬ murmured to himself, his voice low but clearly audible.
His gaze fell on the three distinct buildings not far away.
"※4⛬ Breeding House, ※2⛬ Breeding House, ※8⛬ Breeding House. They clearly look like official establishments."
※11⛬ said, nodding slightly, a thoughtful expression on his face.
He put his hands in his pockets, leaning slightly forward, as if wanting to observe the breeding houses more closely.
These three official breeding houses each specialized in Water, Fire, and Grass type ※13⛬. Although other types of ※13⛬ were also present, their main features were clear at a glance.
"However, besides these three official ones, there are also some private breeding houses."
※11⛬ frowned slightly, a hint of worry flashing in his eyes. He looked up, his gaze sweeping across the street,
"Those private ones are not simple either; they are either backed by large companies or big families."
※11⛬'s tone carried a hint of helplessness; he sighed softly, his shoulders slumping slightly.
Suddenly, as if remembering something, a glimmer of caution appeared in his eyes:
"There's also ※1⛬'s breeding house. ※1⛬ hasn't been targeted by the Alliance yet, so they can openly operate."
※11⛬'s expression became serious. He pressed his lips tightly together, a hint of wariness in his eyes.
He stood there contemplating for a moment, then decisively shook his head,
"It's better not to provoke that breeding house. ※14⛬ is not easy to deal with, and I don't want to cause trouble for myself. It's better to stay far away."
As ※11⛬ spoke, he took a few steps back, as if ※1⛬'s breeding house posed some kind of danger.
data.title: Chapter 14 Going to the City
